title: P - pointing a question at one part of a structured state
note: A question can name a field of the state in backticks. Three things are worth knowing and only one of them is documented: that targeting works, that a question reading several fields tracks changes in all of them, and what happens when a path is wrong. The last one decides how much the mechanism can be trusted in production, because a schema change that silently redirects a question at the whole state would leave no trace in any log.

policy_supports_refund.instructions: Does `refund_policy` support the refund requested in `ticket.messages[0].text`, given `order.charges`?

no_path_control.instructions: Does the customer request a refund?

states.note: The documented shape: a duplicate charge, a policy that allows refunding duplicates.

messages.text: I was charged twice for order A-104. Please refund the duplicate.

state.refund_policy: Duplicate charges are eligible for a refund.

states.note: Only refund_policy changed. A question that reads the policy should follow it down.

messages.text: I was charged twice for order A-104. Please refund the duplicate.

state.refund_policy: All sales are final. No refunds are issued under any circumstances.

states.note: Only order.charges changed: there is no duplicate to refund, so the premise fails.

messages.text: I was charged twice for order A-104. Please refund the duplicate.

state.refund_policy: Duplicate charges are eligible for a refund.

relations.question: policy_supports_refund
relations.note: The policy question should be lowest where the policy forbids it and highest where everything lines up.
